bx5qej6n.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
bx5qej6n.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
bx5qej6n.sourceDescription: This hinged pre-lit Christmas tree is an ideal addition to any space in need of a splash of Christmas merriment. This beautiful Christmas tree with branches made of PVC and PE. Additionally, the included steel stand provides your tree with optimal stability. Thanks to the energy-efficient LED lights, it lights up beautifully and creates a cosy holiday atmosphere. Featuring pine cones sprinkled throughout needles, this Xmas tree will bring any home to life. Tree branches are attached at the centre pole using a hinge system. Due to the hinges, the branches will automatically move to the right position. Have fun during the holidays with this lovely Christmas tree! Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Each product comes with an assembly manual in the box for easy assembly. Product Specifications Colour: Green and white Material: PVC, PE, steel Total height: 150 cm Tree diameter: 90 cm With 327 PVC tips and 212 PE tips Decorated with 30 pine cones Voltage: DC 5 V Power: 6.5 W With 150 LEDs With hinged construction Easy assembly and storage Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

v161jceg.baseName: Ark Mat 70cm Artificial Wreath - Botanical Green
v161jceg.variantName: Ark Mat 70cm Artificial Wreath - Botanical Green
v161jceg.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom
